defect: The empty-input special case in GetData was rekeyed from is_implicit_aggr to grouping_set.empty() but still asserts the output chunk holds only aggregates and writes aggregates[i] into chunk.data[i], which is wrong (assert or out-of-bounds/misplaced columns) for an empty grouping set inside GROUPING SETS where the chunk also carries the group columns that must be NULL.
reason: The transformer at this commit already produces an empty grouping set next to non-empty ones, and the fix repairs exactly these added lines by emitting NULL group columns and offsetting the aggregate columns.

defect: PyGenericAlias::check_ unconditionally evaluates types.GenericAlias, which does not exist before Python 3.9, so the implicit conversion to DuckDBPyType raises AttributeError on Python 3.7/3.8 (the version the Windows CI runs).
reason: The inline check_ was added by this change and the fix replaces it with an import-cache lookup that tolerates a missing attribute, the same repair an intermediate commit already applied to the analogous UnionType (3.10+) check.

defect: When rewriting the Windows IsPathAbsolute check 3 as an early return, the change tested PathMatched(path, sub_path) instead of PathMatched(path_aux, sub_path), so drive-letter paths such as C: followed by a backslash are no longer recognised as absolute.
reason: The original code used path_aux, the change introduced the wrong variable, and the fix swaps it back.

defect: The new forward-scanning codepoint logic does not handle end <= start (e.g. offset 0 with negative length gives start 0, end -1), so it returns the whole remaining string instead of an empty string.
reason: The removed SubstringStartEnd path handled offset 0 by returning empty, so the rewritten branch regressed, and the fix adds the missing end <= start check to these added lines.

defect: The new index_scan_function only fetches the row ids found in the persistent index and never scans the transaction-local storage, so rows appended but not yet committed in the current transaction are missing from index-scan results.
reason: The removed DataTable::IndexScan in data_table.cpp did scan transaction.storage after the index, so this change regressed it, and the fix restores the local storage scan in the new function.

defect: On Windows, PathSeparator was changed to recognise only the file:/ prefix, so JoinPath with a bare file: base (as the commit's new no-host test builds it) inserts a backslash and yields an unrecognised file:-backslash URL, failing the Windows build of the commit's own test.
reason: The no-host file URL support was new in this change, the failing combination arises from its PathSeparator line, and the fix changes exactly that line to accept the bare file: prefix.

defect: unbound_expressions.reserve(art.unbound_expressions) passes a vector instead of a size, which does not compile.
reason: The line was added by this change and the fix adds the missing .size() to repair the build.

defect: The new in-loop check reads the shared exceptions vector (empty() and exceptions[0]) without holding the executor lock while worker threads push errors into it under that lock, a data race.
reason: The unlocked read inside the task loop, which runs concurrently with other threads, was added by this change, and the fix replaces it with a locked GetError accessor.

defect: The fix makes ResultCollectorIsBlocked skip blocked tasks that are not result-collector sinks and return true if any one is, instead of returning false at the first such task.
reason: At this commit every blocked task in the final pipeline was asserted to be a result-collector sink, so the all-or-nothing check was consistent; the hang only became possible after later commits (a99891a made hash-aggregate GetData block, eefcd8e switched to any-sink semantics) let other blocked tasks coexist.

defect: The new Node::ToString prepends indent spaces for PREFIX nodes, while Prefix::ToString (also added in this change) already indents, so prefix lines in the ART pretty printer are indented twice.
reason: The double indentation comes from the lines this change added, and the fix (same day) disables the extra indent loop in the PREFIX case; it is a minor output defect of a debug printer.

defect: Switching join_nodes_in_full_plan from relation-set strings to JoinNode pointers makes the check count(new_plan.get()) look up a freshly allocated node that can never be in the set, so must_update_full_plan is never set when a node of the full plan is replaced, reopening the use-after-free the mechanism guards against.
reason: The pointer-based lookup was introduced by this change and the fix restores a set-string-based lookup for exactly this check.

defect: CreateChildPipeline now copies operators up to op in a loop but the old assignment child_pipeline->operators = current->operators was left after it (and pop_back removed), so the child pipeline gets all operators of the current pipeline, including its own source.
reason: The change replaced the pop_back logic yet kept the overwriting assignment directly after its new loop, and the fix deletes that line (alongside other scheduling corrections).

defect: The rewritten Normalize guards the division with done > 0.0 instead of total > 0.0, so a zero total still divides by zero when done is positive and a negative done is left unnormalised.
reason: The guard was written by this change to replace the removed total <= 0 handling and tests the wrong variable; the fix changes exactly that condition.

defect: The new StringAggLong benchmark ends with FINISH_BENCHMARK(StringAggShort), redefining global_instance_StringAggShort (compile error in the benchmark build) and never registering StringAggLong.
reason: The copy-paste error is in lines added by this change and the fix renames the macro argument to StringAggLong.
